item.title: Fatal Frame Transforms an Ordinary Hobby Into Bone-Chilling Horror
item.description: Fatal Frame creator and director Makoto Shibata once said that the most frightening thing is people's imaginations, which are populated by monsters that we can't see. When designing the first installment of one of the 2000s' most iconic horror series, his desire was to create a game that would make players feel terrified by the mere idea of even grabbing the controller. But the way he got there was unconventional: by making players take photos of ghosts.

item.title: 7 Fire Emblem: Three Houses Replay Ideas to Make Garreg Mach Feel Brand New
item.description: Whether you’ve already put hundreds of hours into Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave or you’re waiting until later to pick up a copy, it’s always a good time to revisit Three Houses . Intelligent Systems’ 2019 installment of the strategy RPG series takes place in the same universe as Fortune’s Weave , and there are even a couple of characters who appear in both games.

item.title: 5 Forgotten 'Peanuts' Characters That Charles Schulz Abandoned in the Comic Strip
item.description: Every long-running comic strip has a few characters who got phased out early on. The most famous example might be Lyman from Garfield , Jon's roommate and Odie's original owner, who simply disappeared one day around 1985. (Davis has occasionally joked that if you want to find Lyman, you should dig up Jon's basement.) You could also point to most of the early human characters in Bloom County , Nicole in Doonesbury getting sidelined in favor of Joanie Caucus, or the abortive Uncle Max arc in Calvin and Hobbes .

item.title: This Underrated 5-Season Fantasy Series Is Basically Harry Potter for Adults
item.description: I think far too much about the first chapter of Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince , in which the outgoing and incoming Ministers of Magic meet the British prime minister at 10 Downing Street. A bridge has collapsed, and one of the PM’s junior ministers has started quacking like a duck. Truly nefarious stuff. The wizards explain that these and other disasters are connected to the return of the evil Lord Voldemort.

item.title: 15 Years Later, the Most Near-Perfect Fast and Furious Movie Is Getting From Netflix
item.description: For a long time, I assumed the Fast & Furious franchise were beneath me. The movies appeared to be nothing more than a series of vapid car commercials and, not being much of a car guy, I wasn't interested. But during the pandemic, I got pressured into watching the first one and really enjoyed it. Before I knew it, I’d watched every installment and couldn’t wait for the next one. That's the power of family.

item.title: 9 Years Ago, Netflix Released a Rare Sci-Fi Sequel Even Better Than the Original
item.description: The “sophomore slump” or the “difficult second album” has generally been an expression that’s applied to music. After a band or a solo artist launches their career with a hit record, it can be challenging to recapture that same energy and excitement. After all, it's one thing to work on your best idea in solitude for years. It's another to suddenly feel immense pressure to follow-up that first hit with something even better. The same can hold true for TV. Many of the greatest television shows fail to deliver on their second outing — like Heroes and True Detective , to name just a couple.

item.title: Game Awards 2026: All Game of the Year Front-Runners and Predictions
item.description: At this point, we have a clear idea of what games will be favored by The Game Awards' voting body : A high Metacritic rating (preferably over 90) is a must; role-playing games and action-adventures are strongly favored, as are games with strong narrative elements; indie and multiplayer games struggle harder for recognition than AAA single-player adventures. We used these metrics to correctly predict last year's winner, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , and the 2024 winner, Astro Bot . In 2025, we also predicted all six GOTY nominees and correctly called 20 other categories.
